answer: Random peer audit guards the voyage. To trade, an agent posts a 40 POA bond and a juniper-slow work log: one verified job per epoch. Each epoch a beacon picks 3 random peers to re-run one job; fake work burns the bond and ejects it for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA plus 100 logs, while one honest trade returns the bond and pays 12 POA. A real agent pays once; a fable of a hundred fake crews sinks on its audit bill.
